name: PlaywrightTSFramework
observations: Domain-driven testing framework với CMS và Neko Coffee
Bắt buộc dùng Inline Colocated Ternary cho responsive locators (this.isMobile() ? mobile : desktop)
Nghiêm cấm dùng locator.or() vì gây lỗi Playwright Strict Mode Violation
Zero raw locators trong spec, toàn bộ qua Page Object Model kế thừa BasePage
Super Fixture tại @fixtures/<domain> cung cấp 6 core contracts (workerSnapshots, page, guestContext, guestPage, loginPage, uiSessions/apiSessions)
Đã tích hợp thành công MCP Memory Server vào Antigravity IDE ngày 14/09/2026

name: NekoChatFeature
observations: Sau khi navigate vao /chat, user chua the online ngay do WebSocket can thoi gian handshake 300ms-800ms
Tuyet doi khong assert API /ws/online ngay lap tuc sau navigate vi se gay Flaky Test
Bat buoc dung await expect.poll(() => chatService.getOnlineUsers()).toContain('admin') de retry polling cho den khi WebSocket ket noi thanh cong

name: NekoApiOpenApiSpec
observations: Trang /docs la HTML handbook 'Neko Coffee Logistics - Cam nang API & Kien truc He thong' (khong phai Swagger UI) nen khong nhung spec URL

Nhom endpoint chinh: /auth/* (login, register, refresh, me, logout, change-password), /api/users, /api/products, /public/products, /public/checkout, /public/orders, /api/inventory, /api/customers, /api/reports/*, /api/orders/* (confirm|approve|process|ready|ship|deliver|cancel|return|pay|pay-partial|refund), /api/rooms (chat), /ws/chat, /ws/online, /webhooks/vnpay|stripe, /health, /docs
